correctness.rationale: The 24 exact signed-permutation vertices and all 48 edges of squared length 4 are checked in Z[sqrt(2)]; six exhaustive normal-sector sign patterns are proved by the four-form partial order. Each has an exact integer witness whose 48 edge crossings are recomputed, yielding 8 or 12. Haar edge separation has probability theta/pi for theta=arccos((7+4sqrt2)/17); linear expectation fixes both masses. No numerical evidence is substituted for continuum proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact section-type classification for a natural 24-vertex Archimedean body, not an arbitrary small slice. The absence of all intermediate generic polygon sizes and an explicit octagon orientation inequality give a sharp geometric tomography benchmark; the full Haar weights follow from an independent edge-angle identity.
